scope: Four unchanged upstream task texts, five concurrency levels, two batches per cell, fixed randomized order, after an excluded warmup. Short input/output measurements; not 500K-context measurements.

prompts.coding: Write a Python function merge_intervals(intervals) that merges overlapping intervals and returns them sorted. Include a one-line docstring and two example calls.
prompts.json: Return only a JSON object describing a fictional bookstore with keys: name (string), city (string), founded (integer year), genres (array of 5 strings), staff (array of 3 objects, each with name and role). No prose.
prompts.prose: Explain in about 120 words how a refrigerator keeps food cold, for a curious 12-year-old.
prompts.math: A train leaves at 9:40. It travels 212 km at 80 km/h, stops for 12 minutes, then travels 95 km at 60 km/h. At what time does it arrive? Show the steps briefly, then give the final time.

validation_scope.coding: Python syntax and merge_intervals definition; no generated code executed.
validation_scope.json: Requested exact field names, types and list sizes.
validation_scope.math: Expected arrival time14:06 present; not a full proof check.
validation_scope.prose: Nonempty naturally completed answer with reasoning; prose meaning not automatically graded.
